what: PRIMARY LABORATORY Fe I oscillator strengths, vendored so the RYA-780 adjudication reproduces without the network. These are the independent referee: RYA-760 established that neither GES nor VALD can adjudicate FMW (VALD carries FMW's own numbers, 96.6% byte-identical) and that NIST ASD cannot either, because FMW = Fuhr, Martin & Wiese IS a NIST compilation. Only a primary measurement can referee a compilation's scale.
pulled_by: Claude Code (Mr Code) for Ryan Schmitt

files.source: Den Hartog, Ruffoni, Lawler, Pickering, Lind & Brewer 2014, ApJS 215, 23 -- 'Fe I radiative lifetime and branching fractions'
files.method: FTS branching fractions normalised on laser-induced-fluorescence radiative lifetimes -- a primary measurement, independent of every compilation.
files.columns_used: lamAir, E0 (lower level, cm-1), J0, E1, J1, log(gf), e_log(gf), log(gf)P + r_log(gf)P (the previously published value and its reference)

files.source: Ruffoni, Den Hartog, Lawler, Ryde, Pickering & Nave 2014, MNRAS 441, 3127 -- 'Fe I oscillator strengths for Gaia-ESO'
files.method: FTS branching fractions on LIF lifetimes. This is the SAME work the pool already cites as GESHRL14 / 2014MNRAS. -- vendored here so its BAND COVERAGE is checkable rather than assumed.

coverage_of_the_disputed_set.meaning: NO primary laboratory measurement exists for ANY of the 14 disputed Fe I IR transitions. This is a coverage fact about the literature, not a judgement -- so no line can be RE-SOURCED (RYA-354 RECOVERED) today. Den Hartog measured branching fractions out of a different set of upper levels; Ruffoni's Gaia-ESO set targets different multiplets.

what_they_DO_referee.finding: Den Hartog 2014 CORROBORATES the pool's primary-sourced gf values on the 8 lines where they overlap: median (Den Hartog - catalogue) = +0.000 dex, max |delta| 0.10 (BWL+GESHRL n=2 median -0.007; GESHRL14 n=6 median +0.000).
what_they_DO_referee.why_it_matters: The adjudication compares each disputed line against a reference scale built from the pool's primary-sourced lines. That reference is therefore INDEPENDENTLY VALIDATED rather than assumed -- which is the difference between a controlled comparison and a circular one.

matching_rule: Wavelength AND lower-level energy. Wavelength alone at a 0.06 A tolerance produced a FALSE pair: our K07 line at 8876.0059 (EP 4.584 eV) against Den Hartog's 8876.0241 (E0 40491.281 cm-1 = 5.020 eV) -- a different transition, and it would have manufactured a 2.85 dex 'discrepancy'. The EP filter is load-bearing.
